scenarioDescriptions.Home_Cook_with_Pip: Realistic Filipino household data from PreviewData is shown in the Home screen; this deterministic UI run does not call the household API.
scenarioDescriptions.Cook_with_Pip: Cook with Pip recipe search shows Ginisang Kangkong using deterministic recipe data from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Cook_Now: Cook Now shows the locally evaluated Sinigang na Baboy recipe from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Almost_There: Almost There shows the locally evaluated Chicken Adobo recommendation from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.My_Recipes: My Recipes shows stored household recipes from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail: The Sinigang na Baboy detail screen uses deterministic recipe and availability data from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail_Instructions: Recipe instructions are local UI test data from CookWithPipUITestService, not a provider response.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Review_Required: The shopping preview uses deterministic safety-review data from CookWithPipUITestService; no shopping changes are confirmed.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Blocked: The shopping preview uses a deterministic blocked-safety scenario from CookWithPipUITestService; no shopping changes are confirmed.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Offline_Error_Retry: The retry screen is a deterministic offline scenario from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Confirmation_Retry_Pending: The pending-confirmation screen is a deterministic network recovery scenario from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Stale_Preview_Refresh: The refresh screen is a deterministic stale-preview scenario from CookWithPipUITestService.
scenarioDescriptions.Cook_with_Pip_Needs_Review: A household recipe shows a review-required result from CookWithPipUITestService and opens its package-label safety details.
